description: Policy Monitor: economic policy as a GDP channel (no parties, polls or candidates). Policy Uncertainty Index per economy and region (share of news coverage about uncertainty over taxes, spending, regulation, trade and central banks; GDELT, Baker-Bloom-Davis method; 50 = 2017-2022 normal, 10 points = 1 standard deviation; last 30 days and monthly history), trade-policy news reading (tariffs, sanctions, export controls), IMF fiscal impulse (minus the change in the structural balance, % of GDP, incl. current and next year projections), US federal cash flows (Daily Treasury Statement), US Federal Register tariff/sanctions/export-control actions naming the economy, national election calendar with a GDP event study, and World Bank governance indicators. Omit economy for the world view (regions, all economies, upcoming elections, latest actions); give one for its detail.

economy.description: Economy code; omit for the world view

months.description: Months of index history to return (latest last)
